entries.category_description: Supply of goods and services of a kind normally intended for use in agricultural production but excluding capital goods such as machinery or buildings
entries.comment: The reduced rate shall be applied for Disinfection, plague and pest control in wineries and vegetable and fruit storage warehouses. For details see art. 291 para. (2) letter e) of the Fiscal Code and point 30 of the Annex to the Order no. 4634/2022.
